title: Small business information site using fictional sample data
learningObjectives: Complete small business information site using fictional sample data using the project's existing HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and engineering practices.

understand.concept: A small-business information site can present services, opening information, location context, and contact routes. For learning, use fictional business details and clearly labelled sample data rather than exposing real personal or customer information.
understand.whyItMatters: The project practises information architecture and conversion-focused layout while protecting privacy. Contact actions should be clear and accessible.
understand.analogy: A business site is a digital front desk that helps visitors understand what is offered and how to take the next step.
understand.analogyLimit: The analogy is simplified; project requirements and release quality must be verified against the actual implementation and user needs.

explain.narrative: The content is explicitly fictional. Production contact details must be verified and intentionally published by the business owner.
